name: Paper Workflow Orchestrator Logo
design_language: Constructivism: hard-edged geometric forms, high contrast, functional symbolism
core_concept: A black geometric cloud/brain silhouette contains a white terminal >_ prompt; a red upward arrow cuts diagonally through the form, turning the static Codex symbol into a research progression mark.

elements.name: cloud_brain
elements.shape: geometric, faceted cloud-like silhouette built from straight line segments and chamfered corners
elements.meaning: Codex identity and the accumulated knowledge of the research process

elements.name: terminal_prompt
elements.shape: negative-space >_ cut into the black form
elements.color: background (cream on light, dark on dark)
elements.meaning: Codex / command-line is the invisible engine inside the workflow

elements.name: rising_arrow
elements.shape: bold diagonal arrow ascending from lower-left to upper-right
elements.meaning: Research stages advancing from idea to finalized paper

mark.composition: The arrow pierces the cloud/brain, creating dynamic tension; the terminal prompt sits in the negative space, tying the mark back to Codex.

logotype.font: geometric sans-serif, uppercase, bold weight, wide tracking

tagline.font: geometric sans-serif, uppercase, regular weight, wide tracking

rules: High contrast between ink and parchment.
Red arrow is the single accent color and must remain prominent.

style.edges: hard, clean vectors; chamfered corners on cloud/brain
style.roundness: none on arrow; minimal on cloud/brain chamfers

meaning.cloud_brain: Codex identity and organic growth of knowledge
meaning.rising_arrow: Research stages ascending from idea to finalized paper
meaning.terminal_prompt: Code/Codex is the invisible engine inside the research workflow

constraints: Single connected emblem; no separate floating decorations.
Every visual element must be readable as part of the same form.
Color is flat and geometric, not blended.
The >_ must be negative space, not an overlay.
No text inside the mark; text belongs in the banner lockup only.
